item.title: Temporary pedestrian facility to be placed at Calexico Port of Entry
item.description: CALEXICO, Calif. (KYMA) - A temporary pedestrian facility will be at the Calexico Port of Entry, according to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP). The facility will open on Tuesday, February 10, 2026 at a.m. one block east of the current pedestrian crossings. CBP says the facility will provide more processing lanes to increase capacity.
